metadata.description: Implementation lane for a stack with no bound role, such as Ansible, a Makefile, a shell script or another language, or for a lane whose owned files span two stack families and cannot be split. The dispatch names the owning skills. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

PHP and Laravel implementation lane: controllers, services, repositories, jobs, migrations and their tests. Not for files of another stack beyond incidental files the dispatch lists. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-laravel.binding: Stack binding: this lane is PHP and Laravel. Apply the preloaded /alaa-php-clean-code and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, the preloaded /alaa-octane-performance when config('octane.server') is set or a worker server is planned, the preloaded /alaa-services-contract to cross-service posture and the preloaded /alaa-trust-gateway-auth to auth and trust-context handling. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-laravel-architecture when the change crosses two layers or the public surface; /alaa-data-layer when it changes a table, index, migration, query or cache entry; /alaa-laravel-job-rabbitmq when it changes a queue job that runs on RabbitMQ or its worker configuration; /alaa-async-messaging when it changes a publisher, consumer or outbox; /alaa-laravel-public-api-contract-pack and /alaa-postman-collections when it changes a public route, request, response or error code. Update a derived contract artifact only when your scope names it. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it by path, and load the skill the dispatch names for it first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Vue frontend implementation lane in TypeScript or JavaScript, with Quasar when the repository uses it: components, composables, stores, routes, boot files and their tests. Not for files of another stack beyond incidental files the dispatch lists. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-frontend.binding: Stack binding: this lane is Vue frontend code, with Quasar when the repository uses it. Apply the preloaded /alaa-frontend-developer, /alaa-vue-typescript-clean-code and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, and the preloaded /alaa-quasar-app-vite-v3 only when the repository uses @quasar/app-vite. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-ui-ux-design-system when the change makes a visual-design decision (new tokens, theming, layout, motion or styling), not when it only uses existing tokens; /alaa-indexeddb-browser-storage when it touches IndexedDB or offline storage; /alaa-shaka-player when it touches an adaptive-streaming player; /alaa-mono-package when it touches an internal package under packages/*, its exports map, or how the app consumes it; /alaa-frontend-devops when it changes the build artifact contract, public path or asset base, cache policy, what is compiled into the client bundle, or a frontend CI or delivery gate; /alaa-frontend-doc-annotations when the change is documentation-only (JSDoc or comments added or corrected, with byte-identical build output); /alaa-services-contract when it changes a shared Ala client package (the SDK, Page Kit, UI Kit, app shell or widgets) or code that parses a response or error envelope; /alaa-trust-gateway-auth when it handles a gateway auth response, such as the dropped-bearer marker or a step-up header. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it by path, and load the skill the dispatch names for it first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Go implementation lane: handlers, use cases, repositories, workers, consumers and their tests. Not for Ent or PostgreSQL work on the Ent specialist route, or for files of another stack beyond incidental files the dispatch lists. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-go.binding: Stack binding: this lane is Go. Apply the preloaded /alaa-golang and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, and let /alaa-golang route you to any further Go skill. Apply the preloaded /alaa-golang-clean-code-principles when the repository is an Ala service built on the alaa-go-chi kit, the preloaded /alaa-services-contract to cross-service posture and the preloaded /alaa-trust-gateway-auth to auth and trust-context handling. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-go-chi-development when the repository is the alaa-go-chi kit, or when the change touches a kit surface, generated artifact, contract document or registry row in a consumer of that kit; /alaa-golang-fiber when the repository imports Fiber. Before any data change, check whether /alaa-ent-go-orm-db owns it (go.mod requires entgo.io/ent, or the change is PostgreSQL work that skill owns); if so, return that work to the lead, because it belongs to the Ent specialist route. Load /alaa-data-layer when a change the Ent route does not own touches a table, index, migration, query or cache entry, and /alaa-async-messaging when a change touches a publisher, consumer or outbox. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it by path, and load the skill the dispatch names for it first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: HAProxy implementation lane: proxy configuration and the Lua that HAProxy runs. Never reloads a running proxy or applies a change to one. Not for files of another stack beyond incidental files the dispatch lists. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-haproxy.binding: Stack binding: this lane is HAProxy configuration and the Lua that HAProxy runs. Apply the preloaded /alaa-haproxy and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-haproxy-lua when the change touches Lua; /alaa-trust-gateway-auth when it changes header sanitizing or injection, token verification, claim projection or a step-up header; /alaa-services-contract when it changes a trusted header name, a response or error envelope, or a health or readiness path. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it by path, and load the skill the dispatch names for it first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Delivery infrastructure implementation lane: Dockerfile, Compose or Swarm stack, runtime-kit inputs, Helm chart, Kubernetes manifest and GitLab pipeline changes, with the shell scripts and Makefiles they call. Not for application code or HAProxy, and never applies, deploys or releases anything. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-delivery.binding: Stack binding: this lane is delivery infrastructure: container images, runtime files, charts, manifests and pipelines. Apply the preloaded /alaa-testing-strategy and /alaa-services-contract. Before the first edit, name the surface of each owned file and load its owner: /service-runtime-kit-governance first for the runtime inputs or generated Compose or Docker files of a service-runtime-kit consumer; /alaa-docker-production for a Dockerfile, .dockerignore, Compose file or Swarm stack; /alaa-k8s-helm for a Helm chart or Kubernetes manifest, with /caas-arvan-kuber only when the manifest or chart would differ on Arvan CaaS from stock Kubernetes; /alaa-gitlab-ci-cd for a GitLab pipeline file or GitLab runner configuration, with /alaa-cicd-laravel-postgres for the gates of a Laravel service and /alaa-frontend-devops for the gates of a frontend; /alaa-bash-shell for a Bash or POSIX sh script and /alaa-makefile for a Makefile that an owned file calls. For an unlisted surface, load its owning skill when one is installed. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it by path, and load the skill the dispatch names for it first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Advisory read-only planner. The lead ratifies and owns the durable plan; never implements or edits. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.
